title: Adobe Commerce and Magento: attackers can gain admin rights
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 88 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. Ready-made attack tools are public. The severity score is critical (9.1). The exploit prediction score is 90%.

category.label: Website or online store
category.why: It runs public websites, online stores or the software behind them.
category.doThis: Ask whoever runs your website or store to update it.

summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 27, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
